title: Refund Schedule for the Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
Refund entitlements on the Self-Pay Visit Package differ by tier in whether a prorated refund exists after the full-refund window, the administrative fee and the way visits already used are valued. The windows, processing time and card-refund period are the same on every tier.

| Tier | Full-refund window | Prorated refund after the window | Administrative fee on a prorated refund | Valuation of visits already used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | 14 calendar days | No | $0.00 | single-visit rate |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | 14 calendar days | Yes | $25.00 | single-visit rate |
| Core 8-Visit Package | 14 calendar days | Yes | $25.00 | single-visit rate |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | 14 calendar days | Yes | $35.00 | single-visit rate |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | 14 calendar days | Yes | $35.00 | package rate |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | 14 calendar days | Yes | $50.00 | single-visit rate |

| Term common to all six tiers | Value |
|---|---|
| Refund issued after approval within | 14 calendar days |
| Refund returned to the original card when issued within this many calendar days of that card payment (later refunds are paid by check) | 120 calendar days |
| Patient's signed cancellation request required | Yes, on every tier |

**Definitions**

- *Full-refund window* — the calendar days after the purchase date within which a package with no visits used is refunded in full.
- *Prorated refund* — whether unused visits are refunded on a prorated basis after the full-refund window.
- *Administrative fee* — the fee deducted from a prorated refund; it is never deducted from a full refund.
- *Single-visit rate* — visits already used are valued at the tier's single-visit cash rate.
- *Package rate* — visits already used are valued at the purchase price divided by the visits included.
- *Processing period* — the calendar days after a refund request is approved within which the refund is issued.

**Points of reading**

The Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package is the only tier whose used visits are valued at the package rate; the other five tiers value them at the single-visit rate. The Starter 4-Visit Package has no prorated refund, and its administrative fee is $0.00.
